alternatives_considered.approach: Store decisions only as decision.recorded raw_events envelopes with payload validation and no new tables
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: TR-6 requires an immutable StateSnapshot row that every decision references by id with a 422 on unknown ids; a foreign-key-grade reference needs a snapshots table, and querying filtered journal rows plus calibration over loose event payloads repeats the funnel-table workaround instead of reusing the repository pattern

alternatives_considered.approach: Put the frozen replay runner in src/workflows/scheduler.js as a scheduled job
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: IAC-2 needs a deterministic synchronous replay CI can assert zero mutations on; the scheduler adds timers and resume semantics the calibration report does not need, so a pure domain evaluateReplay function over fixture scenarios is smaller and directly testable

validated_work_order.approach: Add a pure domain module src/domain/decisions.js owning decision validation (state_snapshot_id required and must exist, alternatives must include do-nothing with a reason, expected distributions, downside, evidence plus memory refs, critic result, policy id, model and prompt versions), maturity-derived evaluation status (awaiting-maturity with expected evaluation date = decided_at plus 120h, the lag-model maturity horizon), calibration math (precision = directionally-correct matured decisions / all matured evaluated decisions; false-intervention rate = matured interventions whose matured outcome was no better than do-nothing / all matured interventions), a frontier rule (a met CPL target never stops proposals; do-nothing is recorded with a reason), and a synchronous frozen-replay evaluator that takes fixture scenarios and returns a calibration report while issuing zero capabilities. Persist with migration 003 adding state_snapshots and decisions tables with append-only triggers plus tenant-scoped repositories; expose POST /v1/snapshots, POST /v1/decisions (400 MISSING_STATE_SNAPSHOT or MISSING_DO_NOTHING, 422 UNKNOWN_SNAPSHOT, idempotent re-post of the same decision_id returns the existing id), GET /v1/decisions with class and status filters in deterministic decided_at, decision_id order, GET /v1/decisions/:id full detail, and GET /v1/calibration. Upgrade the /journal page to read the decisions repository: server-rendered filter selects, a detail drawer fed by the detail endpoint with focus returned to the invoking row on close, a calibration summary, and partial rows showing awaiting maturity plus expected evaluation dates with the error shell naming the failed scenario and keeping prior rows with per-scenario retry. Seed writes one snapshot plus a matured decision, an awaiting-maturity decision, and a do-nothing decision so the journal is non-empty on boot.
assumptions: Decisions #17 (measurement) and #18 (Meta read) are merged, so computeFunnel, maturityFor, policyBand, and the FakeMetaAdsProvider patterns exist to reuse
No mutation or approval execution is in scope: the replay path must not import the executor or policy kernel, and the journal drawer has no approve or execute button
Money in decisions (expected value deltas) stays in integer micros per TR-1; the drawer formats via the existing money module
validated_work_order.confidence_rationale: Contract and screen both map onto existing patterns (repositories with tenant scoping and append-only triggers, server-rendered pages with ?state= shells, node:test suites); the new surface is calibration arithmetic and drawer wiring, both pinned with computed examples in the file changes.

files.change: New pure module with: DECISION_CLASSES list; validateDecisionRecord(input) requiring decision_id (dec_ prefix), tenant_id, state_snapshot_id, decided_at UTC ISO-8601, alternatives array containing exactly one action do_nothing entry with a non-empty reason plus at least one non-do-nothing alternative, expected_outcomes distributions as {mean,p10,p90} numbers, risk {expected_downside_micros integer, worst_reasonable_case string}, evidence_refs and memory_refs arrays, critic_result string, policy_decision_id string, model_versions and prompt_versions arrays; errors are {code,message,details} with stable codes MISSING_STATE_SNAPSHOT, MISSING_DO_NOTHING, BAD_DISTRIBUTION, INVALID_MONEY. evaluationStatus(decision, nowIso): matured when nowIso >= expectedEvaluationAt, else awaiting-maturity; expectedEvaluationAt = decided_at + 120h (the maturityFor horizon where score reaches 1.0). Example computed: decided 2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z -> expected evaluation 2026-09-25T00:00:00.000Z. Invariant: every unevaluated decision carries an expected evaluation date. calibrationReport(evaluations): precision = correct/total over matured evaluated, falseInterventionRate = needless interventions/total matured interventions; example computed: 10 matured (7 correct, 3 wrong, of 6 interventions 2 needless) -> precision 0.70, false-intervention 0.33. frontierCheck(episode): hitting the CPL target returns keepProposing true and requires at least one do-nothing decision with reason. evaluateReplay(scenarios): folds frozen scenarios into a calibration report, imports nothing that can mutate (no executor, no policy kernel, no fetch), returns {precision, falseInterventionRate, evaluated, mutationsExecuted: 0}.

Add migration 003_journal_tables creating state_snapshots (tenant_id, snapshot_id PRIMARY KEY per tenant, decided basis KPIs JSON, budgets JSON, funnel JSON, health JSON, memories JSON, created_at) and decisions (tenant_id, decision_id, state_snapshot_id, action_class, selected_action, record JSON, decided_at, expected_evaluation_at, status) with BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE triggers aborting on both tables (decisions append-only like raw_events; snapshots immutable), plus status index on (tenant_id, status, decided_at).

Add createStateSnapshotRepository (create idempotent on snapshot_id, get tenant-scoped, list deterministic by created_at, snapshot_id) and createDecisionRepository (create idempotent on decision_id returning {created:false,id} on re-post, get tenant-scoped, list with optional class/status filters ordered by decided_at, decision_id, evaluated-list for calibration) behind createRepositories as snapshots and decisions; all SQL binds tenant_id; no update or delete surface.

Add POST /v1/snapshots (201 {snapshot_id}, 400 on bad body with {code,message} envelope), POST /v1/decisions (runs validateDecisionRecord then snapshots.get, 400 MISSING_STATE_SNAPSHOT or MISSING_DO_NOTHING etc, 422 UNKNOWN_SNAPSHOT {code:'UNKNOWN_SNAPSHOT',message:'unknown state snapshot ...'} writing nothing, 201 {decision_id, status, expected_evaluation_at} with idempotent re-post returning the existing id), GET /v1/decisions?class=&status= (deterministic decided_at, decision_id order), GET /v1/decisions/:id (full record: alternatives, expected_outcomes, risk, evidence_refs, memory_refs, critic_result, policy_decision_id, model_versions), GET /v1/calibration (precision, false_intervention_rate, evaluated, awaiting_maturity counts computed from the decisions repository). Unknown snapshot id is a 422; nothing executes.

Rewrite journal(): ideal renders a filter form (two native selects, action class and status, GET submit, labelled, keyboard operable) plus a table (When, Action class, Selected, Expected, Matured, Status with row counts and deterministic sort) where each row is a link/button opening the detail drawer; the drawer shows alternatives including the do-nothing entry with its reason, expected effect distributions (mean/p10/p90), downside estimate with worst-reasonable-case, evidence and memory refs, critic result, and policy decision id, plus a Close button returning focus to the invoking row; below the table a calibration summary panel shows precision, false-intervention rate, evaluated and awaiting-maturity counts. Partial renders awaiting-maturity rows with expected evaluation dates (copy: 'Awaiting maturity — expected evaluation 25 Sept 2026'). Error names the failed scenario (copy: 'Replay evaluation failed for scenario replay-2026-09-25. Every prior journal entry is preserved and untouched.') with a per-scenario Retry button. Empty keeps 'Shadow mode has not started' copy and the 'Start the first replay' link. Loading keeps skeleton rows with cached calibration and a refreshing indicator. Narrow widths collapse the table to cards and the drawer to a full-screen overlay per docs/ui.md.

Add drawer behaviour: opening a journal row fetches the detail endpoint content into the drawer region, moves focus into the drawer, announces via the aria-live region, and Close/Escape returns focus to the invoking row; filter selects submit natively with no JS required.

After the existing journey events, write one state snapshot (state_seed_1) then three decisions through the new repositories: a matured budget-change decision with full alternatives and critic/policy ids, an awaiting-maturity decision decided 6h ago (expected evaluation +120h), and a do-nothing campaign-status decision with reason 'qualified CPL within 15% of target; no frontier move beats holding spend'. Reuses fixed ids so re-seeding stays idempotent.

Frozen replay fixture with two scenarios (replay-cpl-hold with 6 matured decisions incl. 2 needless interventions, replay-tracking-outage with 4 matured decisions and 2 awaiting-maturity entries) carrying decided outcomes only, no live timestamps, so evaluateReplay output is byte-deterministic: precision 0.70, false-intervention 0.33 on scenario one. Replay failure fixture replay-broken references a missing snapshot to exercise per-scenario retry preserving prior entries.

validated_work_order.understanding: Issue #19 is the shadow-mode slice of epic #14: before any spend moves, the system records what it would do with predicted impact in a decision journal, evaluates predictions at maturity, and reports calibration (precision, false-intervention rate). The contract face is the decision record (immutable StateSnapshot reference, do-nothing alternative, expected distributions, downside, evidence/memory refs, critic result, policy id, evaluation scheduled at maturity); the UI face is the /journal page (filterable table, detail drawer, calibration summary, all five states). Dependencies #17 (measurement) and #18 (Meta read) are done, so maturity math and provider patterns exist to reuse; the binding epic answer fixes Meta-first ordering. There is no prior plan rejection for this issue.
